profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Santander Consumer USA

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed a cutting-edge auto loan pre-qualification system that
streamlined customer experience, delivered precise pricing for auto
purchases, and is projected to generate multimillion-dollar revenue.
•	Pioneered a paid subscription model adopted by 300+ dealerships,
increasing participation in the pre-qualification platform and driving
additional revenue streams.
•	Collaborated with stakeholders to deliver technical solutions aligned
with business goals, contributing to a 20% increase in revenue through
targeted innovations.
•	Spearheaded the transition to a modernized CI/CD pipeline,
significantly reducing production deployment time while ensuring
seamless synchronization across environments for improved reliability.
•	Led the modernization of a legacy .NET code base shared by 200+
developers, enabling bi-weekly production deployments instead of
quarterly, significantly improving release efficiency.
•	Transformed deployment processes by migrating to TFS with CI/CD
pipelines, facilitating parallel development across 20 teams.
•	Engineered a loan application lifecycle tracking framework that
reduced production issue troubleshooting time from 5 hours to just 1.5
hours.
•	Automated the update of NuGet references across 300+ legacy projects,
reducing wait times for 50+ team members from 3 hours to 5 minutes,
streamlining development workflows.
•	Designed a scalable framework for .NET Core web APIs, empowering
teams to develop new APIs in days rather than weeks.
•	Authored comprehensive training materials that accelerated
onboarding, enabling new team members to achieve productivity
within 1 week instead of the typical 3 weeks.
positions.insights: Entity Framework, Data Models and +33 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented a high-traffic loan processing system
handling 32,000+ loans daily, contributing to $6 billion in annual revenue
•	Spearheaded key core business initiatives, generating over $100,000
per business loan application
•	Architected an innovative e-contract solution, saving 4 hours daily and
significantly enhancing productivity.
•	Championed the adoption of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) to
deliver adaptable and maintainable solutions
•	Developed a robust producer/consumer queuing framework
compatible with MSMQ and SQL queues to optimize processing
efficiency
•	Led unit test implementation efforts, achieving over 70% code coverage
on new solutions to ensure high software quality
•	Automated loan submission processes between production and
development environments, ensuring 0% code breakage for enhanced
reliability
•	Directed a team to synchronize data between a legacy mainframe and a
future-state loan origination system
•	Initiated and developed a web portal providing real-time production
data access, streamlining developer support
•	Delivered annual presentations to enhance team productivity and
foster collaboration
•	Mentored new team members to rapidly integrate them into workflows,
boosting overall team efficiency
•	Standardized and consolidated library management using NuGet to
streamline development across the organization
•	Implemented Jenkins CI and Octopus Deploy to accelerate and improve
the deployment pipeline
•	Created automation tools to simplify the generation of QA promotion
documents, saving time and effort
•	Conducted prototype demonstrations with stakeholders to ensure
alignment with business requirements
•	Led a scrum team of 5 developers through 3-week sprints, consistently
delivering high-quality results
•	Facilitated sprint retrospective meetings to identify lessons learned
and improve future sprint outcomes
positions.insights: Entity Framework, Data Models and +26 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Created an employee and customer management system for
Interpreters Unlimited, boosting productivity by 80%.
•	Designed a fundraising platform for Sportsgrants Foundation, raising
over $70,000 for charity initiatives.
•	Collaborated with clients to provide consultation and conduct
prototype demonstrations, ensuring alignment with design
requirements.
•	Supervised a team of 1-3 developers to successfully deliver tailored
software solutions to clients
